CustomField.description: This checkbox field allows bypassing validation rules for Processes, on Opportunity. It is by default unchecked and also not shown on the Page Layout. Use Case: There is a requirement that only a DRD user or System Admin can edit the Close Date. This is enforced via a validation rule. However, we need to bypass this validation rule to allow the system to update the Close Date based on a Drive Date which is done via a Process Builder.
CustomField.label: Bypass Validation Rule
